prompt:
STYLE — QUEST FOR DUSKARA BRAND
Game: a calm single-player island strategy game for macOS. You build a small island town, train knights and archers, sail between 15 islands, and capture Duskara's stronghold before dusk falls on the archipelago.
Visual DNA: low-poly "soft clay" 3D. Chunky, bevelled, rounded primitives with matte, slightly hand-pressed surfaces, premium polymer clay or soft vinyl toys. Cream plaster walls, terracotta and coral roofs, straw roofs, slate roofs, olive-green organic islands, pale aqua shallows over deep teal sea, warm orange setting sun.
Polish: bold readable forms, chunky toy-like volumes, soft top-left key light, crisp highlights on bevelled curves, subtle rim light, soft contact shadows, rich controlled saturation. Calm, inviting, adventurous, careful handmade art. Zero clutter or noise.
Palette: plaster cream #EDDEBF, parchment #F2E8D1, terracotta #C9735C, coral #E08F73, banner red #C76152, sunset orange #F0A64F, accent orange #D17A3D, warm gold #E6B35C, olive #8CAD66, crop green #8CAB61, moss #526E42, shallow aqua #8FC4C8, sea #5F8F9C, deep sea #2A5262, deep teal #1B4A5E, slate roof #70808A, timber #8F6B4A.
Avoid: gothic fantasy, grimdark, realistic humans, photorealism, metallic chrome, lens flare, heavy grain, neon or purple, gloss explosions, watermarks, signatures, UI elements, borders, device mockups and ALL text.
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: GitHub repository social preview background.
Input reference: attached NEW key art, exact reference for miniature clay shapes, palette, sunset lighting and subjects. Recompose the scene genuinely for a 1280×640 px landscape canvas, aspect ratio2:1. Do not stretch the reference or crop objects awkwardly.
Scene: the cozy island town is on the RIGHT, mostly the lower-right half: the same cream watchtower with coral conical roof and little terracotta flag, cream cottages with coral/straw roofs, farm plots, grassy irregular coast, pale aqua shallows, wooden pier with tiny BLUE toy knights and archers. Two little cream-sailed ships on deep teal water. The orange setting sun and distant Duskara stronghold with slate roofs and red pennants are on the LEFT horizon.
Layout: reserve the upper and middle LEFT half as quiet calm sky/open distant water for a horizontal title logo to be composited later. Put sun and stronghold toward far-left/lower-left without filling this upper-left negative space. Keep the town silhouette strong and complete on the right and all important subjects40px inside the edges. Same elevated3/4 camera as reference.
Output: TEXT-FREE art background only. NO logo, NO lettering, NO title, NO UI, NO border, NO frame. Full-bleed opaque image.
inspection: Approved: text-free 2:1 composition with town right, sun and stronghold left, broad upper-left sky for logo.
